events.author: s_63h0z_rn9tGX5c93aI9sgKHb1iJO4JwP9NvPMuXsE
events.body:
## Summary

Upgrade the Markdown data model so BLT-Jobs can support a serious Git-native platform while staying static and repository-backed.

## Scope

- Richer job frontmatter.
- Richer seeker profile frontmatter.
- New organization/company profile model.
- Backward-compatible migration strategy.
- Build script updates.
- Validation script updates.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Define expanded job fields for source platform, review status, provider links, remote mode, tags, skills, salary, expiry, verification, and application mode.
- [ ] Define expanded seeker fields for Git username/platform, contact preference, availability, target roles, proof-of-work, and public-data choices.
- [ ] Add `organizations/*.md` schema or document why it is deferred.
- [ ] Update `scripts/build-jobs.js` to emit new fields while preserving current data.
- [ ] Update `scripts/validate-jobs.js` or add validation coverage for required and recommended fields.
- [ ] Update issue templates to match the schema.
- [ ] Verify with `npm run build:jobs` and `npm run validate:jobs`.

## Parent

Tracked by #12: https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/work_items/2

---

Moved from https://gitlab.com/owasp-blt/blt-jobs/-/issues/6 (opened by @mdkaifansari04 on 2026-06-07).

**Discussion summary**

- Partly done in d6ec12ce23 (build and validate scripts expanded). There is no `organizations/*.md` model yet, and the issue templates now live in `blt-jobs/issue-templates/`.
events.title: blt-jobs: Expand Markdown schemas and validation for jobs, seekers, and organizations
